name: Sky
source:
The sun darkens and casts shadows, and the wind clears her hat. 
Summer sea glimmers. 
White clouds run across the blue sky. 
She waves to me a lot. 
That's something I like in her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
阳光黯淡下来，投下层层阴影，风掀起了她的帽子。
夏日的海面波光粼粼。
白云飞驰于蔚蓝天空。
她不断向我挥手。
我喜欢她这一点。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
